hints.title: Hierarchical Team Aggregate Sum
hints.text: Tally the total valuation of an executive together with all direct and indirect subordinates across the reporting tree.

hints.title: ID Lookup Map and Traversal
hints.text: Index employee objects in a hash map by their ID. Recursively sum the designated person importance and recurse through subordinate identifiers.

hints.title: Importance Sum Blueprint
hints.text: Build map: emp_map = {e.id: e for e in employees}. Define dfs(emp_id): emp = emp_map[emp_id]; return emp.importance + sum(dfs(sub_id) for sub_id in emp.subordinates). Return dfs(id).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Builds dictionary in O(N) time and visits each subordinate node in the hierarchy exactly once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning the list linearly to find each subordinate on every step produces O(N^2) complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash table provides constant time lookup for each employee ID.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of hash map indexing combined with depth-first search or breadth-first search tree traversal.
